scope: First prototype only; existing electrical design, placement and routing retained

blockers.detail: AFC01 requires 0.29–0.31 mm tail thickness and a tighter contact-span tolerance than the Arducam-named F32R mate (0.27–0.33 mm). Exact M0031 seating/flip-latch fit remains unqualified. The supplied numbered-tail photo also raises a possible reversed camera-to-J2 mapping if it shows the unmirrored exposed-contact face; one-to-one pad numbering is not physically signed off.
blockers.closure: Exact M0031 tail/pin drawing or sample dimension, unpowered contact-mapping and fit record: meet AFC01 tail limits, resolve the photographed face/pin-1 reversal, and confirm full seating/latch retention. If reversed mating is confirmed, fix the camera-to-pad mapping and rerun the complete routing/verification/release pipeline. No exact revision drawing or physical measurements are available.

blockers.detail: JLC-specific rotations and centroids remain unapproved for U1, J1, J2, D1, LED1 and U2/U3/U4/U5. CAD rotations are not supplier calibration.
blockers.closure: Review the current BOM/CPL against JLC's assembly preview; record model/landmark alignment and any CPL-only corrections. Gerbers were accepted as 4 layers, 50 x 35 mm; the next step requires an authenticated account.

afterAssembly: Rail/startup/ripple, USB enumeration, camera identity/JPEG capture and thermal/current tests belong to prototype bring-up, not prerequisites requiring an already-built board before the first prototype order.
